meta.source: production-tracker-site.vercel.app — :root variables, body and h1 rules as pasted from DevTools, 2026-10-04

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background (body). The ground everything sits on; carries the grid-line pattern.

tokens.name: card-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed panels and inset areas inside a card. text 15.6:1, green 13.6:1.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised card surface. text 12:1, silver 7.8:1. Pink on card is only 4.0:1 — use pink here at 24px+ or for non-text marks only.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on void, card-deep and card (17:1 on void).

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and labels on any surface (11:1 on void).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines — silver at 10%. Decorative only; not a control border (too faint for 3:1).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Signal / primary accent: live, cleared, go. As text or icon on void or cards (14.8:1); void text on a green fill reads 14.8:1.

tokens.name: green-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind green content (badges, active rows).

tokens.name: green-ring
tokens.usage: Outline / ring around green-tinted elements. Decorative, not a 3:1 focus ring on its own.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The 1px lines of the page-background grid (body background-image), repeated every grid-64.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Secondary brand hue, for fills and large shapes. FAILS as text on void (2.8:1) and cards — never use it for text; text on a purple fill reads 6:1.

tokens.name: purple-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted background for purple-coded areas.

tokens.name: purple-mid
tokens.usage: Stronger purple tint: borders, highlights, hover fills.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Hot accent: attention, alerts, emphasis. As text on void 5.7:1 and card-deep 5.3:1; on card 4.0:1 (large text only). void text on a pink fill reads 5.7:1.

tokens.name: pink-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind pink content.

tokens.name: pink-ring
tokens.usage: Outline / ring around pink-tinted elements.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page headline. On the site: font-size clamp(28px, 4.2vw, 52px), text-wrap: balance, max-width 840px.

tokens.name: hero-h1-gap
tokens.usage: Space below the hero h1 (.hero h1 margin-bottom).

tokens.name: h1-gap
tokens.usage: Default space below an h1 outside the hero.

tokens.name: grid-64
tokens.usage: Background grid cell (body background-size). The page's base module.

tokens.name: h1-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of an h1 line.
